stories.reason: Google's new flagship Gemini 4 Argon release (1101 HN pts) - a first-of-generation model launch, the kind the taste profile says always clears the bar even when saturated.

stories.title: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
stories.reason: Anthropic replaced git with a bespoke VCS (Scion) to handle 30k merges/day; concrete, unusually detailed systems-engineering writeup on scaling code review/CI for agent-era volume.
key_facts: Monorepo merge rate grew from ~2,500/day (May 2026) to 30,000+/day (Sept 2026)
Main-branch history ~100GB; compressed working copy >25GB; CI did ~25M checkouts/day
Built Scion (VCS) and Antique (code review) in-house, migrated off git in 5 months
Each of 3 serving tiers (scion-daemon/scion-cache/scion-server) holds >99% cache hit rate
Infra uses ~200x less CPU/memory than the old git-mirror setup; CI gained ~25% CPU capacity
A 7-person team built it; an AI model rewrote the git-to-Scion ingestion pipeline 20x leaner, 4x faster

stories.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
stories.reason: Anthropic's own data on model-distillation attacks: nation-state-linked extraction via proxy accounts, concrete classifier numbers, and a flagged case of PLA-linked Kimi traffic being routed to Claude - squarely on the AI x cyber line the profile always wants.
key_facts: New defenses cut harvested reasoning data by ~90-99% per early evidence
Reasoning-token extraction by distillers fell 10-100x+ after full classifier rollout
Classifier false-positive rate is under 0.1%; tens of thousands of accounts banned, often within 2 hours
Summarizing reasoning alone dropped a distilled model's SWE-bench Verified score from 80.4% to 71.8%
Cites Zhipu's GLM-5.3 (rated most cyber-capable open-weights model by US CAISI) as a distillation beneficiary
Found a case of Kimi requests secretly routed to Claude, including one tied to a user linked to China's PLA
Anthropic has billed for safeguard-blocked requests (incl. distillation) since Sept 24

Big and unusual, but it's company drama rather than an AI-systems-security story, so ranked as a brief headline rather than a top discovery pick. Could not fetch (sfstandard.com blocked).

stories.title: duty1g/x64dbg-mcp-server
stories.reason: MCP server that lets an AI agent drive the x64dbg debugger directly - real agentic reverse-engineering tooling (~2.5k stars) with full read/write/patch control, squarely AI x cyber with running code.
key_facts: Zig-based x64dbg plugin exposing debugger control over MCP (HTTP/SSE, Bearer auth)
Exposes execution control, all breakpoint types, memory patching, PE/import/export analysis
~2.5k stars, 270 forks; README warns it gives full memory read/write and should not face untrusted networks

stories.title: Janas: Run LLMs larger than RAM by streaming experts from SSD
stories.reason: Small C, no-dependency inference engine that streams MoE experts off NVMe SSD so an 80B model runs on a 32GB laptop - exactly the inference-infrastructure/serving topic the profile always wants, with real code and benchmarks (not just a paper).
key_facts: Streams needed experts from NVMe via O_DIRECT, caches hot experts in RAM; --cache flag caps memory use
Claims an 80B-parameter MoE model runs and answers on a 32GB-RAM laptop
Author benchmark: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B at ~37 tok/s (with speculative drafts) vs 2.8 tok/s for llama.cpp
~343 stars, GPL-3.0, explicitly labelled 'an experiment, not a product'; tested on one laptop only

stories.title: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries
stories.reason: Agentic reverse-engineering MCP toolkit spanning native binaries, Electron/.NET apps, APKs and firmware - broad real adoption and running code, fits the AI x cyber tooling line well.
key_facts: One MCP server covering native binaries, JS/Electron, .NET, websites, Android APKs/devices, firmware, pcaps
Uses existing Hopper/Ghidra/IDA installs for native analysis; static JS analysis needs no native engine
Shipped as npm package 'rea-agents'; registers itself as an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI
Large reported star/fork counts and frequent updates per the repo README
